0:1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
0:1:6: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Diphath, and Togarmah.
0:1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
0:1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
0:1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raama, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raama: Sheba, and Dedan.
0:1:10: And Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
0:1:11: And Mizraim begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
0:1:12: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim—from whence came the Philistines—and Caphtorim.
0:1:13: And Canaan begot Zidon his first-born, and Heth;
0:1:14: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
0:1:15: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite;
0:1:16: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
0:1:17: The Sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
0:1:18: And Arpachshad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.
0:1:19: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
0:1:20: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah;
0:1:21: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah;
0:1:22: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba;
0:1:23: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
0:1:28: The sons of Abraham: Isaac, and Ishmael.
0:1:29: These are their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
0:1:30: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
0:1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedem. These are the sons of Ishmael.
0:1:32: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba, and Dedan.
0:1:33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
0:1:34: And Abraham begot Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau, and Israel.
0:1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jalam and Korah.
0:1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
0:1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
0:1:38: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
0:1:39: And the sons of Lotan: Hori, and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
0:1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah, and Anah.
0:1:41: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
0:1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz, and Aran.
0:1:43: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before their reigned any king over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
0:1:44: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
0:1:45: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
0:1:46: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.
0:1:47: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
0:1:48: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
0:1:49: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
0:1:50: And Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
0:1:51: And Hadad died. And the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Alvah, the chief of Jetheth;
0:1:52: the chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon;
0:1:53: the chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar;
0:1:54: the chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
0:2:1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;
0:2:2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
0:2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; which three were born unto him of Bath-shua the Canaanitess. And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and He slew him.
0:2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
0:2:5: The sons of Perez: Hezron, and Hamul.
0:2:6: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
0:2:7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass concerning the devoted thing.
0:2:8: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
0:2:9: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
0:2:10: And Ram begot Amminadab; and Amminadab begot Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
0:2:11: and Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;
0:2:12: and Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;
0:2:13: and Jesse begot his first-born Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third;
0:2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth;
0:2:15: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh.
0:2:16: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
0:2:17: And Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
0:2:18: And Caleb the son of Hezron begot children of Azubah his wife—and of Jerioth—and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
0:2:19: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
0:2:20: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.
0:2:21: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead; whom he took to wife when he was threescore years old; and she bore him Segub.
0:2:22: And Segub begot Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
0:2:23: And Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages thereof, even threescore cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
0:2:24: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephrath, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
0:2:25: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
0:2:26: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
0:2:27: And the sons of Ram the first-born of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
0:2:28: And the sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
0:2:29: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
0:2:30: And the sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
0:2:31: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
0:2:32: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
0:2:33: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
0:2:34: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
0:2:35: So Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bore him Attai.
0:2:36: And Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;
0:2:37: and Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;
0:2:38: and Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;
0:2:39: and Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;
0:2:40: and Eleasah begot Sisamai, and Sisamai begot Shallum;
0:2:41: and Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.
0:2:42: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his first-born, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
0:2:43: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
0:2:44: And Shema begot Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begot Shammai.
0:2:45: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
0:2:46: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.
0:2:47: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
0:2:48: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
0:2:49: And [the wife of] Shaaph the father of Madmannah bore Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
0:2:50: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur the first-born of Ephrath: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim;
0:2:51: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
0:2:52: And Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim had sons: Haroeh, and half of the Menuhoth.
0:2:53: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites, and the Eshtaolites.
0:2:54: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
0:2:55: And the families of scribes that dwelt at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
0:3:1: Now these were the sons of David, that were born unto him in Hebron: the first-born, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
0:3:2: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
0:3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
0:3:4: Six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
0:3:5: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem: Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
0:3:6: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet;
0:3:7: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia;
0:3:8: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
0:3:9: All these were the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
0:3:10: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam; Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son;
0:3:11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son;
0:3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son;
0:3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son;
0:3:14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
0:3:15: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum. .
0:3:16: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
0:3:17: And the sons of Jeconiah—the same is Assir—Shealtiel his son;
0:3:18: and Malchiram, and Pedaiah, and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
0:3:19: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel, and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
0:3:20: and Hashubah and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
0:3:21: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of [Jeshaiah]: Rephaiah; the sons of [Rephaiah]: Arnan; the sons of [Arnan]: Obadiah; the sons of [Obadiah]: Shecaniah.
0:3:22: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
0:3:23: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
0:3:24: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
0:4:1: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
0:4:2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath; and Jahath begot Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
0:4:3: And these were [the sons of] the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazlelponi;
0:4:4: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur the first-born of Ephrath, the father of Beth-lehem.
0:4:5: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
0:4:6: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Timeni, and Ahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
0:4:7: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, and Zohar, and Ethnan.
0:4:8: And Koz begot Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
0:4:9: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren; and his mother called his name Jabez, saying: ‘Because I bore him with pain.’
0:4:10: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying: ‘Oh that Thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Thy hand might be with me, and that Thou wouldest work deliverance from evil, that it may not pain me! ’ And God granted him that which he requested.
0:4:11: And Chelub the brother of Shuhah begot Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
0:4:12: And Eshton begot Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
0:4:13: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
0:4:14: And Meonothai begot Ophrah; and Seraiah begot Joab the father of Ge-harashim; for they were craftsmen.
0:4:15: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah: Kenaz.
0:4:16: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
0:4:17: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon. And she bore Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa—
0:4:18: and his wife Hajehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah—and these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took.
0:4:19: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
0:4:20: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
0:4:21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, and Ladah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
0:4:22: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records are ancient.
0:4:23: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plantations and hedges; there they dwelt occupied in the king’s work.
0:4:24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamim, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
0:4:25: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
0:4:26: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
0:4:27: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
0:4:28: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual;
0:4:29: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad;
0:4:30: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag;
0:4:31: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
0:4:32: And their villages were Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
0:4:33: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and they have their genealogy.
0:4:34: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah;
0:4:35: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel;
0:4:36: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshoaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah;
0:4:37: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
0:4:38: these mentioned by name were princes in their families; and their fathers’ houses increased greatly.
0:4:39: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
0:4:40: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.
0:4:41: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the Meunim that were found there, and destroyed them utterly, unto this day, and dwelt in their stead; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
0:4:42: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
0:4:43: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
0:5:1: And the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel—for he was the first-born; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel, yet not so that he was to be reckoned in the genealogy as first-born.
0:5:2: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came he that is the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s—
0:5:3: the sons of Reuben the first-born of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
0:5:4: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son;
0:5:5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son;
0:5:6: Beerah his son, whom Tillegath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive; he was prince of the Reubenites.
0:5:7: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief Jeiel, and Zechariah,
0:5:8: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon;
0:5:9: and eastward he dwelt even unto the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates; because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
0:5:10: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
0:5:11: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
0:5:12: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan;
0:5:13: and their brethren of their fathers’ houses: Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
0:5:14: These were the sons of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jehishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
0:5:15: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
0:5:16: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in the towns thereof, and in all the open lands of the plain, upon their borders.
0:5:17: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
0:5:18: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, as many as were valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were forty and four thousand seven hundred and threescore, that were able to go forth to war.
0:5:19: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
0:5:20: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and He was entreated of them, because they put their trust in Him.
0:5:21: And they took away their cattle: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand; and of souls of men a hundred thousand.
0:5:22: For there fell many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their stead until the captivity.
0:5:23: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land, from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon, where they increased.
0:5:24: And these were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
0:5:25: And they broke faith with the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
0:5:26: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tillegath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.
0:5:27: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
0:5:28: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
0:5:29: And the children of Amram: Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
0:5:30: Eleazar begot Phinehas, Phinehas begot Abishua;
0:5:31: and Abishua begot Bukki, and Bukki begot Uzzi;
0:5:32: and Uzzi begot Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begot Meraioth;
0:5:33: Meraioth begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
0:5:34: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Ahimaaz;
0:5:35: and Ahimaaz begot Azariah, and Azariah begot Johanan;
0:5:36: and Johanan begot Azariah—he it is that executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem—:
0:5:37: and Azariah begot Amariah, and Amariah begot Ahitub;
0:5:38: and Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shallum;
0:5:39: and Shallum begot Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begot Azariah;
0:5:40: and Azariah begot Seraiah, and Seraiah begot Jehozadak;
0:5:41: and Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
0:6:1: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath and Merari.
0:6:2: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni, and Shimei.
0:6:3: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
0:6:4: The sons of Merari: Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
0:6:5: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son;
0:6:6: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son. .
0:6:7: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son;
0:6:8: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son;
0:6:9: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
0:6:10: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
0:6:11: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son;
0:6:12: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
0:6:13: And the sons of Samuel: the first-born Vashni; then Abiah.
0:6:14: The sons of Merari: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son;
0:6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
0:6:16: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.
0:6:17: And they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they took their station at their service according to their order.
0:6:18: And these are they that took their station, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel;
0:6:19: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah;
0:6:20: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai;
0:6:21: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah;
0:6:22: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah;
0:6:23: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
0:6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand; even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea;
0:6:25: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah;
0:6:26: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah;
0:6:27: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei;
0:6:28: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
0:6:29: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch;
0:6:30: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah;
0:6:31: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer;
0:6:32: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
0:6:33: And their brethren the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
0:6:34: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of burnt-offering, and upon the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
0:6:35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son;
0:6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son;
0:6:37: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son;
0:6:38: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
0:6:39: Now these are their dwelling-places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, for theirs was the [first] lot,
0:6:40: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and the open land round about it;
0:6:41: but the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
0:6:42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the acity of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with the open land about it, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with the open land about it;
0:6:43: and Hilen with the open land about it, Debir with the open land about it;
0:6:44: and Ashan with the open land about it, and Beth-shemesh with the open land about it;
0:6:45: and out of the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with the open land about it, and Alemeth with the open land about it, and Anathoth with the open land about it. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
0:6:46: And unto the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
0:6:47: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
0:6:48: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
0:6:49: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with the open land about them.
0:6:50: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
0:6:51: And some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
0:6:52: And they gave unto them the bcity of refuge, Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim with the open land about it; Gezer also with the open land about it;
0:6:53: and Jokmeam with the open land about it, and Bethhoron with the open land about it;
0:6:54: and Aijalon with the open land about it, and Gath-rimmon with the open land about it;
0:6:55: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner with the open land about it, and Bileam with the open land about it, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.
0:6:56: Unto the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with the open land about it, and Ashtaroth with the open land about it;
0:6:57: and out of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with the open land about it, Dobrath with the open land about it;
0:6:58: and Ramoth with the open land about it, and Anem with the open land about it;
0:6:59: and out of the tribe of Asher: Mashal with the open land about it, and Abdon with the open land about it;
0:6:60: and Hukok with the open land about it; and Rehob with the open land about it;
0:6:61: and out of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with the open land about it, and Hammon with the open land about it, and Kiriathaim with the open land about it.
0:6:62: Unto the rest [of the Levites], the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with the open land about it, Tabor with the open land about it;
0:6:63: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them, out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with the open land about it, and Jahaz with the open land about it,
0:6:64: and Kedemoth with the open land about it, and Mephaath with the open land about it;
0:6:65: and out of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with the open land about it, and Mahanaim with the open land about it,
0:6:66: and Heshbon with the open land about it, and Jazer with the open land about it.
0:7:1: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
0:7:2: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valour according to their generations, even of Tola; their number in the days of David was two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
0:7:3: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.
0:7:4: And with them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the host for war, six and thirty thousand; for they had many wives and sons.
0:7:5: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valour, reckoned in all by genealogy, were fourscore and seven thousand.
0:7:6: [The sons of] Benjamin: Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
0:7:7: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valour; and they were reckoned by genealogy twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
0:7:8: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jeremoth, and Abijah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
0:7:9: And they were reckoned by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valour, twenty thousand and two hundred.
0:7:10: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
0:7:11: All these were sons of Jediael, even heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valour, seventeen thousand and two hundred, that were able to go forth in the host for war.
0:7:12: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, the son of aanother.
0:7:13: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
0:7:14: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his wife bore—his concubine the Aramitess bore Machir the father of Gilead;
0:7:15: and Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah—and the name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
0:7:16: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
0:7:17: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
0:7:18: And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ish-hod, and Abiezer, and Mahlah.
0:7:19: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
0:7:20: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah—and Bered was his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
0:7:21: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son—and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
0:7:22: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
0:7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because ait went evil with his house.
0:7:24: And his daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
0:7:25: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son;
0:7:26: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son;
0:7:27: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
0:7:28: And their possessions and habitations were Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Aiah and the towns thereof;
0:7:29: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and the towns thereof, Taanach and the towns thereof, Megiddo and the towns thereof, Dor and the towns thereof. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
0:7:30: The sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
0:7:31: And the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
0:7:32: And Heber begot Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
0:7:33: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, and Bimhal, and Asvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
0:7:34: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, and Rohgah, and Hubbah, and Aram.
0:7:35: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
0:7:36: The sons of Zophah: Suah, and Harnepher, and Shaul, and Beri, and Imrah;
0:7:37: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilsha, and Ithran, and Beera.
0:7:38: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, and Pispa, and Ara.
0:7:39: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, and Hanniel, and Rizia.
0:7:40: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number of them reckoned by genealogy for service in war was twenty and six thousand men.
0:8:1: And Benjamin begot Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third;
0:8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
0:8:3: And Bela had sons, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud;
0:8:4: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah;
0:8:5: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
0:8:6: And these are the sons of Ehud—these are the heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geba, and they were carried captive to Manahath;
0:8:7: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, were they that carried them captive—and he begot Uzza, and Ahihud.
0:8:8: And Shaharaim begot children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away, to wit, Hushim and Baara his wives;
0:8:9: he begot of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam;
0:8:10: and Jeuz, and Sachiah, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ houses.
0:8:11: and of Hushim he begot Abitub, and Elpaal.
0:8:12: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof;
0:8:13: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath.
0:8:15: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder;
0:8:16: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, were the sons of Beriah.
0:8:17: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber;
0:8:18: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, were the sons of Elpaal.
0:8:19: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi;
0:8:20: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel;
0:8:21: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, were the sons of Shimei.
0:8:22: And Ishpan, and Ebed, and Eliel;
0:8:23: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan;
0:8:24: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothiah;
0:8:25: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, were the sons of Shashak.
0:8:26: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah;
0:8:27: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, were the sons of Jeroham.
0:8:28: These were heads of fathers’ houses throughout their generations, chief men; these dwelt in Jerusalem.
0:8:29: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon [, Jeiel], whose wife’s name was Maacah;
0:8:30: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab;
0:8:31: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
0:8:32: And Mikloth begot Shimeah. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
0:8:33: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
0:8:34: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
0:8:35: And the sons of Micah; Pithon, and Melech, and Taarea, and Ahaz.
0:8:36: And Ahaz begot Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza;
0:8:37: and Moza begot Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
0:8:38: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
0:8:39: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
0:8:40: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers; and had many sons, and sons’ sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
0:9:1: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel; and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon because of their transgression.
0:9:2: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
0:9:3: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
0:9:4: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
0:9:5: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the first-born and his sons.
0:9:6: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
0:9:7: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
0:9:8: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibneiah;
0:9:9: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were heads of fathers’ houses by their fathers’ houses.
0:9:10: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
0:9:11: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
0:9:12: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
0:9:13: and their brethren, heads of their fathers’ houses, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
0:9:14: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
0:9:15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
0:9:16: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites. .
0:9:17: And the porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brother Shallum the chief;
0:9:18: who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward; they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.
0:9:19: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the Tent; and their fathers had been over the camp of the Lord, keepers of the entry;
0:9:20: and Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, the Lord being with him.
0:9:21: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tent of meeting.
0:9:22: All these that were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
0:9:23: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, even the house of the Tent, by wards.
0:9:24: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
0:9:25: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them;
0:9:26: for the four chief porters were in a set office. These were the Levites. They were also over the chambers and over the treasuries in the house of God.
0:9:27: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge thereof was upon them, and to them pertained the opening thereof morning by morning.
0:9:28: And certain of them had charge of the vessels of service; for by tale were they brought in and by tale were they taken out.
0:9:29: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
0:9:30: And some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.
0:9:31: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were baked on griddles.
0:9:32: And some of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the showbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
0:9:33: And these are the singers, heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites, who dwelt in the chambers and were free from other service; for they were employed in their work day and night.
0:9:34: These were heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites, by their generations, chief men; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
0:9:35: And in Gibeon there dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah;
0:9:36: and his first-born son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab;
0:9:37: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
0:9:38: And Mikloth begot Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against their brethren. .
0:9:39: And Ner begot Kish; and Kish begot Saul; and Saul begot Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
0:9:40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begot Micah.
0:9:41: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Taharea[,band Ahaz].
0:9:42: And Ahaz begot Jarah; and Jarah begot Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begot Moza.
0:9:43: And Moza begot Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
0:9:44: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
0:10:1: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
0:10:2: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
0:10:3: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was in anguish by reason of the archers.
0:10:4: Then said Saul unto his armour-bearer: ‘Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and make a mock of me.’ But his armour-bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell upon it.
0:10:5: And when his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell upon his sword, and died.
0:10:6: So Saul died, and his three sons; and all his house died together.
0:10:7: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that [Israel] fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
0:10:8: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
0:10:9: And they stripped him, and took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry the tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
0:10:10: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
0:10:11: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
0:10:12: all the valiant men arose, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the terebinth in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
0:10:13: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, because of the word of the Lord, which he kept not; and also for that he asked counsel of a ghost, to inquire thereby,
0:10:14: and inquired not of the Lord; therefore He slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
0:11:1: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying: ‘Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
0:11:2: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was thou that didst lead out and bring in Israel; and the Lord thy God said unto thee: Thou shalt feed My people Israel, and thou shalt be prince over My people Israel.’
0:11:3: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Samuel.
0:11:4: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem—the same is Jebus—and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
0:11:5: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David: ‘Thou shalt not come in hither.’ Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion; the same is the city of David.
0:11:6: And David said: ‘Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.’ And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
0:11:7: And David dwelt in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
0:11:8: And he built the city round about, from Millo even round about; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
0:11:9: And David waxed greater and greater; for the Lord of hosts was with him.
0:11:10: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who held strongly with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
0:11:11: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the captains; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them at one time.
0:11:12: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
0:11:13: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
0:11:14: But they stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great victory.
0:11:15: And three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, unto the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
0:11:16: And David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
0:11:17: And David longed, and said: ‘Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate! ’

0:13:1: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
0:13:2: And David said unto all the assembly of Israel: ‘If it seem good unto you, and if it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad everywhere unto our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites that are in their cities that have open land about them, that they may gather themselves unto us;

0:13:7: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, [and brought it] out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

0:17:1: And it came to pass, when David dwelt in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet: ‘Lo, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord dwelleth under curtains.’

0:17:7: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto My servant David: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be prince over My people Israel;

0:17:10: even from the day that I commanded judges to be over My people Israel; and I will subdue all thine enemies. Moreover I tell thee that the Lord will build thee a house.

0:17:12: He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
0:17:13: I will be to him for a father, and he shall be to Me for a son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee;
0:17:14: but I will settle him in My house and in My kingdom for ever; and his throne shall be established for ever.’
0:17:15: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
0:17:16: Then David the king went in, and sat before the Lord; and he said: ‘Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my house, that Thou hast brought me thus far?
0:17:17: And this was a small thing in Thine eyes, O God; but Thou hast spoken of Thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me after the manner of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

0:17:19: O Lord, for Thy servant’s sake, and according to Thine own heart, hast Thou wrought all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

0:18:1: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
0:18:2: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought presents.
0:18:3: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah by Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion at the river Euphrates.
0:18:4: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for a hundred chariots.
0:18:5: And when the Arameans of Damascus came to succour Hadarezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Arameans two and twenty thousand men.
0:18:6: Then David put [garrisons] in Aram Damascus; and the Arameans became servants to David, and brought presents. And the Lord gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
0:18:7: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
0:18:8: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadarezer, David took very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
0:18:9: And when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah,
0:18:10: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to salute him, and to bless him—because he had fought against Hadarezer and smitten him; for Hadarezer had wars with Tou—and [he had with him] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
0:18:11: These also did king David dedicate unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
0:18:12: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah smote of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
0:18:13: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord gave victory to David whithersoever he went.
0:18:14: And David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness unto all his people.
0:18:15: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder.
0:18:16: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
0:18:17: and Beniah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
0:19:1: And it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
0:19:2: And David said: ‘l will show kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.’ So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
0:19:3: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun: ‘Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?’
0:19:4: So Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their hips, and sent them away.
0:19:5: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them; for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said: ‘Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.’
0:19:6: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Aram-naharaim, and out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.
0:19:7: So they hired them thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; who came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
0:19:8: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
0:19:9: And the children of Ammon came out and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
0:19:10: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Arameans.
0:19:11: And the rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
0:19:12: And he said: ‘If the Arameans be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me; but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
0:19:13: Be of good courage, and let us prove strong for our people, and for the cities of our God; and the Lord do that which seemeth Him good.’
0:19:14: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh unto the battle to meet the Arameans; and they fled before him.
0:19:15: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Arameans were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
0:19:16: And when the Arameans saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and brought out the Arameans that were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer at their head.
0:19:17: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel together, and passed over the Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Arameans, they fought with him.
0:19:18: And the Arameans fled before Israel; and David slew of the Arameans the men of seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
0:19:19: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and served him; neither would the Arameans help the children of Ammon any more.
0:20:1: And it came to pass, at the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out to battle, that Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and overthrew it.
0:20:2: And David took the crown of Malcam from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head; and he brought forth the spoil of the city, exceeding much.
0:20:3: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. And thus did David unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
0:20:4: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai, of the sons of the giants; and they were subdued.
0:20:5: And there was again war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
0:20:6: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six [on each hand], and six [on each foot]; and he also was born unto the giant.
0:20:7: And when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
0:20:8: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
0:21:1: And Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to number Israel.
0:21:2: And David said to Joab and to the princes of the people: ‘Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know the sum of them.’
0:21:3: And Joab said: ‘The Lord make His people a hundred times so many more as they are; but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of guilt unto Israel?’
0:21:4: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
0:21:5: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand men that drew sword; and Judah was four hundred three-score and ten thousand men that drew sword.
0:21:6: But Levi and Benjamin he did not number among them; for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
0:21:7: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore He smote Israel.
0:21:8: And David said unto God: ‘I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing; but now, put away, I beseech Thee, the iniquity of Thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.’
0:21:9: And the Lord spoke unto Gad, David’s seer, saying:
0:21:10: ’Go and speak unto David, saying: Thus saith the Lord: I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.’
0:21:11: So Gad came to David, and said unto him: ‘Thus saith the Lord: Take which thou wilt:
0:21:12: either three years of famine; or three months to be swept away before thy foes, while the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even pestilence in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to Him that sent me.’
0:21:13: And David said unto Gad: ‘I am in a great strait; let me fall now into the hand of the Lord, for very great are His mercies; and let me not fall into the hand of man.’
0:21:14: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel; and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
0:21:15: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it; and as he was about to destroy, the Lord beheld, and He repented Him of the evil, and said to the destroying angel: ‘It is enough; now stay thy hand.’ And the angel of the Lord was standing by the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
0:21:16: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord standing between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
0:21:17: And David said unto God: ‘Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? let Thy hand, I pray Thee, O Lord my God, be against me, and against my father’s house; but not against Thy people, that they should be plagued.’
0:21:18: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and rear an altar unto the Lord in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
0:21:19: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.
0:21:20: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons that were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
0:21:21: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed down to David with his face to the ground.
0:21:22: Then David said to Ornan: ‘Give me the place of this threshing-floor, that I may build thereon an altar unto the Lord; for the full price shalt thou give it me; that the plague may be stayed from the people.’
0:21:23: And Ornan said unto David: ‘Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes; lo, I give thee the oxen for burnt-offerings, and the threshing-instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal-offering; I give it all’
0:21:24: And king David said to Ornan: ‘Nay, but I will verily buy it for the full price; for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer a burnt-offering without cost.’
0:21:25: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
0:21:26: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings, and called upon the Lord; and He answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt-offering.
0:21:27: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword back into the sheath thereof.
0:21:28: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
0:21:29: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt-offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
0:21:30: But David could not go before it to inquire of God; for he was terrified because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
0:22:1: Then David said: ‘This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of burnt-offering for Israel.’ .
0:22:2: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
0:22:3: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
0:22:4: and cedar-trees without number; for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought cedar-trees in abundance to David.
0:22:5: And David said: ‘Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries; I will therefore make preparation for him.’ So David prepared abundantly before his death.
0:22:6: Then He called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for the Lord, the God of Israel.
0:22:7: And David said to Solomon: ‘My son, as for me, it was in my heart to build a house unto the name of the Lord my God.
0:22:8: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying: Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars; thou shalt not build a house unto My name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in My sight.
0:22:9: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
0:22:10: He shall build a house for My name; and he shall be to Me for a son, and I will be to him for a father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
0:22:11: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as He hath spoken concerning thee.
0:22:12: Only the Lord give thee discretion and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel; that so thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.
0:22:13: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel; be strong, and of good courage; fear not, neither be dismayed.
0:22:14: Now, behold, in my straits I have prepared for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight, for it is in abundance; timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
0:22:15: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all men that are skilful in any manner of work;
0:22:16: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.’
0:22:17: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son:
0:22:18: ’Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath He not given you rest on every side? for He hath delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before His people.
0:22:19: Now set your heart and your soul to seek after the Lord your God; Arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.’
0:23:1: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
0:23:2: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
0:23:3: And the Levites were numbered from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
0:23:4: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to oversee the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges;
0:23:5: and four thousand were doorkeepers; and four thousand praised the Lord ‘with the instruments which I made to praise therewith.’
0:23:6: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
0:23:7: Of the Gershonites: Ladan, and Shimei.
0:23:8: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
0:23:9: The sons of Shimei: Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Ladan.
0:23:10: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
0:23:11: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
0:23:12: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
0:23:13: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated, that he should be sanctified as most holy, he and his sons for ever, to offer before the Lord, to minister unto Him, and to bless in His name for ever.
0:23:14: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons are named among the tribe of Levi.
0:23:15: The sons of Moses: Gershom, and Eliezer.
0:23:16: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
0:23:17: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
0:23:18: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
0:23:19: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
0:23:20: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.
0:23:21: The sons of Merari: Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar, and Kish.
0:23:22: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their brethren the sons of Kish took them to wife.
0:23:23: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
0:23:24: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses, according to their muster, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from twenty years old and upward.
0:23:25: For David said: ‘The Lord, the God of Israel, hath given rest unto His people, and He dwelleth in Jerusalem for ever;
0:23:26: and also the Levites shall no more have need to carry the tabernacle and all the vessels of it for the service thereof.’
0:23:27: For by the last ordinances of David the sons of Levi were numbered from twenty years old and upward.
0:23:28: For their station was at the side of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of the house of God;
0:23:29: for the showbread also, and for the fine flour for a meal-offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked on the griddle, or of that which is soaked, and for all manner of measure and size;
0:23:30: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;
0:23:31: and to offer all burnt-offerings unto the Lord, on the sabbaths, on the new moons, and in the appointed seasons, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually, before the Lord;
0:23:32: and that they should keep the charge of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, for the service of the house of the Lord.
0:24:1: And the courses of the sons of Aaron were these. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
0:24:2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
0:24:3: And David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.
0:24:4: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.
0:24:5: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for they were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
0:24:6: And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites: one father’s house being taken for Eleazar, and proportionately for Ithamar.
0:24:7: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah;
0:24:8: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim;
0:24:9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin;
0:24:10: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah;
0:24:11: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah;
0:24:12: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim;
0:24:13: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab;
0:24:14: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer;
0:24:15: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez;
0:24:16: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel;
0:24:17: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul;
0:24:18: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
0:24:19: These were the orderings of them in their service, to come into the house of the Lord according to the ordinance given unto them by the hand of Aaron their father, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
0:24:20: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
0:24:21: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
0:24:22: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
0:24:23: And Benai, Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
0:24:24: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
0:24:25: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
0:24:26: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, his son,
0:24:27: even the sons of Merari through Jaaziah his son: Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
0:24:28: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
0:24:29: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
0:24:30: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.
0:24:31: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers’ houses of the chief even as those of his younger brother.
0:25:1: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals; and the number of them that did the work according to their service was:
0:25:2: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph; under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied according to the direction of the king.
0:25:3: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six; under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the Lord.
0:25:4: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;
0:25:5: all these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the things pertaining to God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
0:25:6: All these were under the hands of their fathers for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the direction of the king—Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
0:25:7: And the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in singing unto the Lord, even all that were skilful, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
0:25:8: And they cast lots ward against [ward], as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
0:25:9: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph; The second to Gedaliah; he and his brethren and sons were twelve;
0:25:10: The third to Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:11: The fourth to Izri, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:12: The fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:13: The sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:14: The seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:15: The eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:16: The ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:17: The tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:18: The eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:19: The twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:20: For the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:21: For the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:22: For the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:23: For the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:24: For the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:25: For the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:26: For the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:27: For the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:28: For the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:29: For the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:30: For the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
0:25:31: For the four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
0:26:1: For the courses of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites: Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
0:26:2: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the first-born, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth;
0:26:3: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
0:26:4: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the first-born, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth;
0:26:5: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.
0:26:6: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valour.
0:26:7: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, and Rephael and Obed and Elzabad his brethren, valiant men; Elihu also, and Semachiah.
0:26:8: All these were of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men in strength for the service; threescore and two of Obed-edom.
0:26:9: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, valiant men, eighteen.
0:26:10: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief—for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief—
0:26:11: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
0:26:12: These courses of the doorkeepers, even the chief men, had wards over against their brethren, to minister in the house of the Lord.
0:26:13: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
0:26:14: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a discreet counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
0:26:15: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the Storehouse.
0:26:16: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goeth up, ward against ward.
0:26:17: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the Storehouse two and two.
0:26:18: For the Precinct westward, four at the causeway, and two at the Precinct.
0:26:19: These were the courses of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
0:26:20: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God, and over the treasuries of the hallowed things.
0:26:21: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ houses belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
0:26:22: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
0:26:23: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites;
0:26:24: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.
0:26:25: And his brethren by Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
0:26:26: This Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
0:26:27: Out of the spoil won in battles did they dedicate to repair the house of the Lord.
0:26:28: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
0:26:29: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sorts were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
0:26:30: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward; for all the business of the Lord, and for the service of the king.
0:26:31: Of the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ houses. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
0:26:32: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred, heads of fathers’ houses, whom king David made overseers over the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God, and for the affairs of the king.
